Hello. I managed to do 5 pull-ups.

Anyway, this update adds a nice new feature along with a few bug fixes.

ΓùÅ Added the ability to select the displayed vehicle from a list

Fuel Record allows you to register an unlimited number of vehicles, and quite a few users actually have multiple vehicles registered. However, switching between vehicles was previously limited to moving through them one by one using the left and right buttons. If you had many vehicles registered, this meant tapping repeatedly to get to the one you wanted, which wasnΓÇÖt very convenient.

In fact, IΓÇÖve received requests from users asking to select vehicles from a list, and this update adds that feature.

If you have multiple vehicles registered, tap the vehicle name at the top of the screen (the part that shows something like ΓÇ£XXX RecordsΓÇ¥). This will open a menu where youΓÇÖll find a new option called ΓÇ£Select Vehicle.ΓÇ¥ Tapping that will show a list of your registered vehicles, and you can choose one from there.

I think this will be especially useful for those who have many vehicles registered, so please give it a try.

Also, regarding the issue where the app could occasionally crash right after launch, IΓÇÖm still investigating it. The previous update improved things quite a bit, but it seems the issue can still occur in rare cases. IΓÇÖm sorry to those who have experienced this.

In this update, IΓÇÖve implemented an additional fix, so I believe it should be further improved, but IΓÇÖll continue to keep a close eye on it for a while.
